note: This file is a pure configuration file (dict-based config for MMSegmentation). It defines model settings for an FCN UNet (s5-d16) architecture with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. No example tool invocations are applicable.
config_description: Configuration for an EncoderDecoder model using a UNet backbone with 5 stages and 64 base channels, paired with FCN decode and auxiliary heads for 2-class semantic segmentation

key_settings.backbone: UNet with 5 stages, base_channels=64, SyncBN normalization, ReLU activation, InterpConv upsampling
key_settings.decode_head: FCNHead with 64 input channels from stage 4, 1 conv layer, 0.1 dropout, 2 output classes
key_settings.auxiliary_head: FCNHead with 128 input channels from stage 3, 1 conv layer, 0.1 dropout, 2 output classes, loss_weight=0.4
key_settings.data_preprocessor: SegDataPreProcessor with ImageNet mean/std normalization, BGR to RGB conversion
key_settings.test_cfg: Slide mode inference with 256x256 crop size and 170 pixel stride
